_readme: Copy this file to config.json. Use env:VAR_NAME for the password to keep credentials out of the file.

jtapi._comment_lib_dir: Place your Cisco JTAPI plugin jars in the lib/ folder next to this file.
jtapi._comment_default_target: Which phone to use when --target is not specified on the command line.

targets._comment: Replace with your phone's details. device_name is the SEP MAC from CUCM Device Inventory.
targets.name: my-phone
